How Korea Builds Miniature Bullet Trains from Real Train Blueprints

Company homepage and sales site : https://www.korea-brass.com/
email : GICKH@KOREA-BRASS.COM

Hello from King Process!
How much of a real high-speed train can you recreate in miniature using the original blueprints?
In this video, we take a look at how Korea Brass makes its 1/87 scale model of the KTX Sancheon, one of South Korea’s high-speed trains. Using the original design drawings, Korea Brass recreated the train’s streamlined body and windows, right down to the seating layout inside the passenger cars.
There’s even a little of the real KTX Sancheon in this miniature. Korea Brass melted down material from a component in the train’s power conversion system and used it to make the model.
